annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Turret Angular Tracking & Target Priority Calculator

description: Evaluates radar contacts by range, transversal velocity, and Tribe standing to output deterministic Smart Turret target-lock priorities and fire authorizations. Use when ranking active grid radar contacts for automated Smart Turret engagement; for reviewing historical solar system killmails and ambush probabilities before transit, use analyze_eve_killmail_threats instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'turret_id' ('engagement_doctrine' defaults to 'highest_threat'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

engagement_doctrine.description: Target selection doctrine weighting range vs angular tracking; defaults to 'highest_threat' when omitted.

name: prioritize_eve_turret_targets

primary_target_lock.description: Contact ID of the highest-priority hostile vessel to engage.
